notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR register page describes this tower. Two searches found no history, builder, staffing or dates. The Secretary of State list entry 'Bolivar Fire Tower (Sold 8/11/2018)' is in Bolivar County but the list does not tie it to the Pace tower, so the story says so and does not link them. A TowerDex listing of a 121.9 m structure in Pace registered to Bolivar County E911 was seen only in search results; it is not a fire lookout at the register's height, so it was not used. Height converted from 110 ft. Record county and coordinates match the register.
